<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OrderDelivery" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-delivery">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderDelivery">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderProcess" name="Order delivery process" processRef="Process_OrderDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsProvider" name="Logistics provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order placed online or by phone" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Handover" name="Shipment handed over" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsProvider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tracking" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderDelivery" name="Order delivery" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed online or by phone">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Generate_SendConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Generate_SendConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendConfirmation_PickPack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickPack" name="Pick and pack items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendConfirmation_PickPack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PickPack_GenerateLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PickPack_GenerateLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateLabel_HandOver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOverShipment" name="Hand over shipment to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateLabel_HandOver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandOver_SendTracking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandOver_SendTracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendTracking_Monitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendTracking_Monitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotDelivered_Monitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Monitor_DeliveryDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DeliveryDecision" name="Reached customer's address?" default="Flow_NotDelivered_Monitor">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Monitor_DeliveryDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delivered_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotDelivered_Monitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Delivered" name="Successfully delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Delivered_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_PostDelivery">
      <bpmn:text>Customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions; those actions are not specified here.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>

    <bpmn:association id="Association_PostDelivery" sourceRef="EndEvent_Delivered" targetRef="Annotation_PostDelivery"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_GenerateConfirmation" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Generate_SendConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmation_PickPack" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickPack_GenerateLabel" sourceRef="Task_PickPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateLabel_HandOver" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandOverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandOver_SendTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendTracking_Monitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_DeliveryDecision" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="Gateway_DeliveryDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivered_End" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shipmentReachedCustomersAddress</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotDelivered_Monitor" name="Not yet" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryDecision" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackOrReturn_TakeAction</bpmn:incoming>
